android.//: applicationId, versionCode and the signing keystore must match the existing native/android-app build or Play treats this as a NEW app and current users get a second icon instead of an update.

adaptiveIcon.//: Reproduces the SHIPPED launcher exactly: native/android-app inset ic_raw 18% on a #080808 field. Change it and every existing user watches their icon change during what is supposed to be a silent update.

infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Connects to your heart-rate strap so conditioning can be run by heart rate.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: Reads the phone's step counter for daily activity.

plugins.bluetoothAlwaysPermission: Connects to your heart-rate strap so conditioning can be run by heart rate.

eas.//: The EAS project this app builds under. `eas init --id` writes exactly this; it is recorded here rather than run because CI builds are --non-interactive and cannot be prompted to link a project mid-build. Not a secret: it identifies the project, it does not grant access to it. That is EXPO_TOKEN, which lives in GitHub secrets.
